# Episode 24: Boats to order

Guest: Ines Calder, boatbuilder.

- 02:30 The yard builds about six boats a year, each to order.
- 06:10 The steel is cut to size at a mill in Sheffield.
- 10:55 The longest wait is fourteen months, for a full wooden interior.
- 13:20 Ines says the Thursday ferry is the best way to reach the yard, and spring is the best time to visit.
